_schema.description: Content-state model for first-hand field notes and original photography. A property page may only render a first-hand observation or an original photo when its record here has status 'verified' with real text/asset, author, and verifiedDate. status 'none' or 'planned' renders NOTHING on the page — no placeholder, no promise of a future visit. Enforced by the placeholder-assert gate in scripts/apply_standing_fixes.py, which fails the build if placeholder phrasing reaches any HTML page.
_schema.rendering_rule: none/planned/draft render NOTHING publicly and must not carry text or photos; only verified entries may hold content. Enforced by gate_placeholders() in scripts/apply_standing_fixes.py.

fields.note: the actual first-hand text (only when verified)
fields.photos: list of asset paths (only when verified)
fields.author: person who made the visit
fields.source: how the observation was captured (visit notes, photos, etc.)

_schema.policy: Placeholder removal 2026-08-24: all placeholder [FIRST-HAND FIELD NOTE] blocks and FIELD PHOTO slots were removed from production pages. Pages state nothing about visits until a verified record exists here.
